annotations.text:
Direction: butcher-paper editorial x forge. Warm paper, iron panels, one ember accent, letterpress cards with hard offset shadows. Bricolage Grotesque + IBM Plex Mono.
Repo was empty - no design system to match, so this commits to a bold default; two alternates sit on the Directions page.

Week Board = home. Dinners by default (lunch/breakfast rows are a later setting). Weekend columns tinted. Cards carry time, serves, and one optional tag - nothing else.
Built: the board defaults to TWO stacked week rows (this week + next) with a 1wk/2wk toggle; drags cross weeks and the market list shops the whole fortnight. This artboard shows a single week row.

The Forge shows all three beats on one screen - no wizard. Extractor order: JSON-LD, then microdata, then heuristics; paste-the-page-text fallback for robot-blocking sites. The strip report is the product's signature moment.
Market List aggregates the week's recipes: same item + compatible units merge (with a per-recipe source count), aisle-sorted. Spice rail is check-the-cupboard, not buy. Prints as a one-page receipt.
Two alternate directions, low-fi on purpose. If either fits the family better than the forge identity, say so and the framework page gets rebuilt in that direction.
